_comment: NSE equity (CM segment; identical to F&O) trading holidays that fall on a weekday, 2019-2026. Single source of truth for TypeScript (lib/nseHolidays.ts) and Python (lib/nse_holidays.py): edit only here. Source: NSE's own holiday-master API, https://www.nseindia.com/api/holiday-master?type=trading&year=YYYY (CM segment), read 2026-10-05; 2026 also matches the NSE web page (docs/NSE_HOLIDAYS_2026.md). Weekend holidays are omitted. Years with no entry degrade to weekdays-only. MCX has its own calendar and is not covered. Reconciled against the repo's NIFTY daily/1-min and options data: the only holiday-dated rows are the 2025-10-21 Muhurat session.

special_sessions._comment: Sessions that exist in market data but are NOT regular 09:15-15:30 sessions. Backtests and indicators should drop them (see is_regular_session / isRegularSession). Muhurat: the Diwali Laxmi Pujan one-hour session (2021-11-04, 2022-10-24, 2024-11-01 and 2025-10-21 are in the data with 60 bars; 2023-11-12 is a Sunday; 2026-11-08 is announced by NSE with timings still to come). 2025-10-21 is also a weekday holiday above; the other weekday Muhurat days trade, so they are not holidays. Saturday: special live sessions seen in the 1-min data (09:15-12:30) — not verified against an NSE circular.
